approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse the complete terminal-run workflow index to bound one exact RFI or Submittal's primary sources.
Require the literal question form the <label> field and an exact line-leading case/whitespace-equivalent source label.
Keep known semantic fields on their dedicated stronger contracts and add no synonym or semantic interpretation.
Apply the same exact label, identity and complete-value contract to ordinary answers and comparison source findings.
Fail closed on missing labels, conflicts, cross-scope borrowing, Email-prefixed labels, headers, quoted history, signatures, vision narration and oversized source sets.
title: Answer exact company-specific workflow fields
objective: Answer bounded company-specific RFI and Submittal fields locally without adding synonyms or weakening exact evidence grounding.
